name: Cobra Pose
description: Lift the chest into a small backbend while lying face down, keeping the pelvis and legs grounded.

items.content: Lie face down with legs extended and tops of feet on the floor; place palms beside the lower ribs.
Keep elbows bent and close to the body as you draw the chest forward and up.
Use the back muscles with light hand support; leave the pelvis and legs on the floor.
Keep the neck in line with the spine and lift only to a comfortable height without pinching the lower back.
Breathe gently, then lower the chest slowly.

stages.name: Hold
stages.description: Lying face down with pelvis, legs and tops of feet grounded. Chest lifted a short distance, palms beside lower ribs, elbows bent alongside the torso and neck long.
